title: Business Central Trivia Recap: August 24–28, 2026
summary: Business Central Trivia August 2026 round recap shows 4,993 answers across 250 questions with 68% accuracy. Subscription Billing, Sustainability, and Keyboard Shortcuts remained the hardest categories, while Acronyms and Development topics were easiest. The trivia platform added new features including badges, player awards pages, and UI improvements.
key_points: The 5-day trivia event had 250 questions in 29 categories with 4,993 total answers and 68% correct rate
Tuesday had the highest accuracy at 75%, Friday the lowest at 63%
Subscription Billing (30%) and Sustainability (44%) were consistently the hardest topics across rounds
New features include 62 achievement badges, public player awards pages with privacy controls, improved password reset, and fixed leaderboard navigation

quotes.text: 62 badges across 16 families for day streaks, correct-answer runs, questions answered, accuracy, podium finishes
quotes.why_it_matters: New gamification mechanics drive engagement and recognition of player achievements
